messages: mira: quick thought 1: collapse 'Workloads' into two clear entries: 'Models' and 'Deploys' in the left nav. deep links need to be copy/paste friendly for infra teams. evan: agree. canonical paths make ops life easier. propose /orgs/:orgId/projects/:projectId/models/:modelId and similar for deploys. also add short alias redirects like /m/:id -> canonical. sophia: sidebar UX: when group is collapsed to icons only, ensure tooltips are persistent on hover and labels remain for screen readers (aria-label). keyboard users need visible text through SR-only spans. emma: (dev-bot) note: implement history API routing + server rewrite rules so OG metadata can be served for shared links. otherwise social previews show generic title. mira: breadcrumb rule: keep shallow: Org > Project > Models > Model Name. use display names where available; fallback to slugified id. no deep nesting in breadcrumbs. evan: a11y checklist: aria-current on active nav item, aria-expanded on group toggles, skip-link at top of page to jump to main content. a11y-bot, any quick wins? a11y-bot: flagged missing skip link and inconsistent focus after nav changes in prototype. recommend adding: Skip to main content and ensure focus moves to main heading after route change. also role=navigation on the left nav. sophia: microcopy: use Plural for list pages ("Models"), Singular for detail titles ("Model"). Title Case in breadcrumbs. emma: dev route snippet to sync with ops: ``` /projects/:projectId/models /projects/:projectId/models/:modelId /projects/:projectId/deploys/:deployId ``` will add redirect map for /m/:id and /d/:id aliases. mira: action items: 1) sophia to update Figma for collapsed nav + SR labels, 2) evan to draft redirect list and route table, 3) emma/ops to add SSR shim for OG tags, 4) a11y-bot to produce small e2e keyboard test plan. evan: i'll also add telemetry event deep_link_open with origin=nav|share so we can measure shareability. mira: cool. short review tomorrow at 10am to confirm proto. thanks :sparkles:
